nodes.description: Owner address of Ownable; controls privileged functions such as transferOwnership and drain gating.
Pending owner address in Claimable; set by transferOwnership and consumed by claimOwnership.
Mapping(address=>mapping(bytes4=>bool)) of granted selectors in SelectorBasedAccessManager; read by hasAccessTo.
Immutable target contract address that SelectorBasedAccessManager forwards calldata to.
Boolean flag that allows anyone to call submitBlocksWithCallbacks when true.
Counter of open forced withdrawal requests, incremented in forceWithdraw.
Transfers ownership to newOwner; guarded by onlyOwner.
Finalizes ownership transfer; guarded by onlyPendingOwner.
Drains ETH or ERC20 from the contract; only callable by accounts allowed by canDrain.
Returns whether drainer is authorized to drain a given token.
Sends ETH to an address using a low-level call with a custom gas limit.
Wraps sendETH and reverts on failure.
Performs an arbitrary low-level call and copies the returned data.
Wraps fastCall and bubbles up revert data on failure.
Dispatches signature verification to ERC1271 or ECDSA depending on whether signer is a contract.
Performs a staticcall to an untrusted signer implementing ERC1271.isValidSignature.
Recovers an ECDSA signer using ecrecover with malleability bounds checks.
Performs a low-level token.call to transfer and validates the returned boolean.
Forwards calldata to target via a low-level call; guarded by withAccess.
Returns true if user is owner or has the selector permission granted.
Decompresses block data, processes receiver callbacks and forwards the call to the exchange.
Creates a forced withdrawal request; refunds ETH surplus and stores block.timestamp.
Withdraws a pending deposit once its age exceeds maxAgeDepositUntilWithdrawable; uses block.timestamp.
Executes a withdrawal through the deposit contract using a try/catch external call and records block.timestamp for protocol fees.
Attempts the token transfer and tracks amountWithdrawable when it fails.
Decompresses zero-run encoded calldata using inline assembly (calldataload/calldatacopy).
External callback invoked on registered receivers during block submission.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and drain access.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for withdrawal timing and refund-of-age logic.
recipient.call{value: amount, gas: gasLimit} forwards value to an arbitrary address.
signer.staticcall(callData) invokes untrusted contract code during signature verification.
token.call{gas: gasLimit}(callData) invokes an arbitrary token contract.
ecrecover(signHash, v, r, s) used to derive the signer address.
Inline assembly loop using calldataload/calldatacopy to build the output bytes in memory.
Destination address parameter of drain.
Token address parameter of drain (address(0) means ETH).
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Address whose drain authorization is queried in canDrain.
Gas limit applied to the external token call in safeTransferWithGasLimit.
Computed ETH/ERC20 amount being drained.
Signer address passed to verifySignature.
Signature bytes passed to verifySignature.
Expected account owner for a forced withdrawal.
Account id for which a forced withdrawal is requested.

edges.reason: onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before executing transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read in the onlyOwner comparison.
onlyPendingOwner requires msg.sender == pendingOwner before claimOwnership.
pendingOwner is read and cleared inside claimOwnership.
drain is gated by canDrain(msg.sender, token).
canDrain return value decides whether drain may proceed.
hasAccessTo compares msg.sender against owner or the permissions mapping.
owner is compared in hasAccessTo to grant implicit access.
permissions mapping is read in hasAccessTo for selector grants.
withAccess modifier requires hasAccessTo(msg.sender, selector) before transact.
transact forwards the calldata to the target contract.
drain sends ETH out through sendETHAndVerify before finishing.
sendETHAndVerify delegates the ETH transfer to sendETH.
sendETH performs recipient.call{value: amount} to a caller-influenced address.
drain transfers ERC20 tokens using the safe transfer helper.
safeTransferWithGasLimit performs an arbitrary token.call.
gasLimit parameter bounds the external token call.
verifySignature routes contract signers to verifyERC1271Signature.
verifyERC1271Signature staticcalls untrusted signer code.
verifySignature routes EOA signers to recoverECDSASigner.
recoverECDSASigner calls ecrecover to derive the signer.
fastCallAndVerify invokes fastCall and handles failures.
fastCall executes an arbitrary low-level call to the target.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks forwards the decompressed payload via fastCallAndVerify.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks decompresses the payload when isDataCompressed is set.
decompress relies on inline assembly calldataload/calldatacopy on user supplied data.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks requires hasAccessTo(msg.sender, SUBMITBLOCKS_SELECTOR) or open.
open flag bypasses the permission check for submitBlocksWithCallbacks.
distributeWithdrawal calls transferTokens which performs the external withdrawal.
transferTokens stores block.timestamp as protocolFeeLastWithdrawnTime.
forceWithdraw refunds the ETH surplus through sendETHAndVerify.
forceWithdraw records uint64(block.timestamp) in the forced withdrawal request.
withdrawFromDepositRequest compares block.timestamp against the deposit age.
numPendingForcedTransactions is checked and incremented by forceWithdraw.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks invokes IBlockReceiver.beforeBlockSubmission on external receivers.
to parameter determines the drain destination.
token parameter selects ETH or ERC20 drain path.
newOwner parameter becomes the new owner state variable.
drainer parameter is evaluated by canDrain.
amount local holds the drained balance before transfer.
signer parameter is used to select the verification path.
signature parameter is forwarded to the verification routines.
owner parameter is stored in the forced withdrawal request.
accountID parameter indexes the pendingForcedWithdrawals mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address is only meaningful as an argument of drain.
Token selector is consumed solely by drain to choose the transfer path.
newOwner is assigned directly to the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
drainer is the only input evaluated by canDrain before a drain is allowed.
gasLimit bounds the external token call performed by safeTransferWithGasLimit.
amount is a transient local computed and forwarded by drain.
signer determines the branch taken inside verifySignature.
signature bytes flow into the verification routines of verifySignature.
owner is stored as part of the forced withdrawal request.
accountID indexes the pendingForcedWithdrawals mapping in forceWithdraw.
